name: RecallGraph

colorMode.reason: Daylight Forensics makes evidence readable across sustained investigation. The docket remains a single carbon closure surface, not a separate visual mode.

typography.display: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif
typography.body: Avenir Next, Avenir, Segoe UI, sans-serif

motion.rule: Use opacity and transform for purposeful feedback only; respect reduced motion.

logoCarrierRule: The approved Linear Stitch geometry remains unchanged. Its graphite lineage and heritage vermilion closure stitch stay on the warm-bone carrier; do not reverse, recolor, or introduce a new logo variant.

state.selection: Petrol pairs an aria-pressed state with a thicker border and inset keyline; selection is never colour-only.
state.risk: Oxide is reserved for risk strokes, closure stitching, and large/high-emphasis treatment. It is not small normal text on light evidence surfaces.
state.complete: Use explicit written status and a non-colour cue alongside petrol or carbon treatment; do not introduce green.
